classification: Presentation of an authenticated retrospective metadata-feasibility receipt; no new optimization or experiment

class_panel_support.scope: All 58 recorded sessions, all 30 nonself ordered endpoint classes; eligible after frozen split/global contributor embargo
class_panel_support.left_text: Training count above development count; color encodes training count
class_panel_support.right: Number of sessions with at least 5 training and 1 development source for each pair considered separately
class_panel_support.selected_outline: Nine classes of the already fixed/executed K9 design

class_panel_frontier.x_spacing: Equally spaced fixed-K categories; lines only guide the eye
class_panel_frontier.marker_offsets: Small fixed horizontal offsets distinguish the two gates; no y values altered
class_panel_frontier.gate5: Maximum admitted recorded columns under at least 5 train and 1 development source for every selected class/session
class_panel_frontier.gate3: Maximum admitted columns under at least 3 train and 1 development source, conditional on achieving the gate5 width optimum
class_panel_frontier.sessions: Session counts for the chosen panels, not separately maximized session objectives
class_panel_frontier.execution: Only K9 is the fixed/executed study; all other K values are retrospective metadata-only alternatives
class_panel_frontier.uncertainty_intervals: None; these are deterministic metadata counts

limits: K9 was fixed before class selection; this retrospective frontier does not show that nine globally maximizes width or decoding performance
No alternative K was evaluated by fitting or decoding in this receipt
Class panels can differ across K and are constrained by balanced start/goal degree; frontier points are not nested-class interventions
Neither marginal source totals nor passing single-pair gates establish a joint multisession population
Counts do not establish biological independence, simultaneity or natural-trial prediction
